unresolved.title: An Introduction to the Study of the Kabalah
unresolved.author: W. Wynn Westcott
unresolved.query: Introduction to the Study of the Kabalah Westcott
unresolved.epithet: The Golden Dawn founder's primer of the Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: Westcott's short introduction to the doctrines of the Kabbalah for the English student — the compact primer that shaped how the Golden Dawn and its heirs understood the Tree of Life.

unresolved.title: Sefer ha-Zohar (Mantua edition)
unresolved.author: attributed to Shimon bar Yochai
unresolved.epithet: The Book of Splendour in its first printing
unresolved.summary: The Zohar, the central book of the Kabbalah, in the Mantua editio princeps — the mystical commentary on the Torah whose Aramaic pages became the scripture of Jewish mysticism.

unresolved.title: Tikkunei ha-Zohar
unresolved.author: attributed to Shimon bar Yochai
unresolved.epithet: Seventy meditations on the first word of the Torah
unresolved.summary: The 'Emendations of the Zohar', seventy discourses expounding the first word of Genesis — a distinct and enormously influential stratum of the Zoharic literature, printed at Mantua.

unresolved.title: Pardes Rimonim
unresolved.author: Moses Cordovero
unresolved.epithet: The Orchard of Pomegranates: Kabbalah systematised
unresolved.summary: Cordovero's great systematic exposition of the Kabbalah before Luria — thirteen 'gates' ordering the whole doctrine of the sefirot — printed in Kraków and foundational for all later study.

unresolved.title: Or Ne'erav
unresolved.author: Moses Cordovero
unresolved.epithet: A defence of and gateway to the study of Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: Cordovero's short apologia for the study of the Kabbalah and abridged introduction to his own system — the accessible doorway to the vast Pardes Rimonim.

unresolved.title: Reshit Chochmah
unresolved.author: Elijah de Vidas
unresolved.epithet: The Beginning of Wisdom: Kabbalistic ethics
unresolved.summary: De Vidas's vast manual of moral and devotional life drawn from the Zohar and the school of Safed — the book that carried Cordoverian Kabbalah into everyday Jewish piety.

unresolved.title: Avodat ha-Kodesh
unresolved.author: Meir ibn Gabbai
unresolved.epithet: The Service of Holiness, a summa before Luria
unresolved.summary: Ibn Gabbai's systematic theology of the Kabbalah — on the divine unity, the commandments and prayer — regarded as one of the most coherent statements of the doctrine before the Lurianic turn.

unresolved.title: Emek ha-Melech
unresolved.author: Naftali Bacharach
unresolved.epithet: The Valley of the King: Lurianic Kabbalah diffused
unresolved.summary: Bacharach's influential and controversial presentation of the Lurianic system — the tzimtzum, the breaking of the vessels and the tikkun — one of the channels by which Luria's Kabbalah spread through Europe.

unresolved.title: Derech Hashem (The Way of God)
unresolved.author: Moshe Chaim Luzzatto
unresolved.query: Derech Hashem Luzzatto Way of God
unresolved.epithet: The Ramchal's ordered theology of providence
unresolved.summary: Luzzatto's lucid systematic account of God, providence, the soul and the purpose of creation — the most accessible statement of the Lurianic worldview by the great Ramchal.

unresolved.title: Kalach Pitchei Chochmah (138 Openings of Wisdom)
unresolved.author: Moshe Chaim Luzzatto
unresolved.epithet: A hundred and thirty-eight gates to Lurianic wisdom
unresolved.summary: Luzzatto's systematic key to the Lurianic Kabbalah in one hundred and thirty-eight numbered 'openings' — his attempt to render Isaac Luria's system rationally intelligible.

unresolved.title: Ma'arekhet ha-Elohut
unresolved.author: anonymous
unresolved.epithet: The Order of God: an early systematic Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: One of the earliest systematic treatises of the Kabbalah, laying out the ten sefirot as an ordered structure of divinity — printed with commentaries at Mantua and Ferrara and long a standard text.

unresolved.title: Chesed le-Avraham
unresolved.author: Abraham Azulai
unresolved.epithet: A Safed sage's springs of Lurianic wisdom
unresolved.summary: Azulai's popular compendium of Kabbalistic teaching organised as 'springs' and 'rivers' — a widely read gateway to the doctrines of Cordovero and Luria from the sage of Hebron.

unresolved.title: Sha'arei Kedushah (The Gates of Holiness)
unresolved.author: Hayyim Vital
unresolved.query: Shaarei Kedushah Vital Gates of Holiness
unresolved.epithet: Luria's disciple on the path to the holy spirit
unresolved.summary: Vital's manual of ethical and meditative preparation for prophecy and the holy spirit — the practical, attainable face of the Lurianic Kabbalah he did most to record.

unresolved.title: Shenei Luchot ha-Berit
unresolved.author: Isaiah Horowitz
unresolved.epithet: The Shelah: law and Kabbalah interwoven
unresolved.summary: Horowitz's encyclopaedic work — known by its initials, the Shelah — weaving law, ethics and Lurianic mysticism into a guide for the whole of Jewish life, hugely influential in later piety.

unresolved.title: Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh
unresolved.author: anonymous
unresolved.epithet: The Book of the Angel Raziel: practical Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: The composite grimoire of practical Kabbalah — angelic names, amulets and cosmology said to have been given to Adam by the angel Raziel — in the much-copied Amsterdam printing kept as a house-amulet.

unresolved.title: Imrei Shefer
unresolved.author: Abraham Abulafia
unresolved.epithet: The ecstatic Kabbalist on letters and prophecy
unresolved.summary: One of Abulafia's manuals of 'prophetic Kabbalah' — the meditative permutation of the Hebrew letters and divine names as a technique for reaching prophecy — from the founder of the ecstatic school.

unresolved.title: Zohar Hadash
unresolved.author: attributed to Shimon bar Yochai
unresolved.epithet: The 'New Zohar' gathered from the leftover leaves
unresolved.summary: The Zohar Hadash, the Zoharic material assembled from manuscripts not included in the Mantua and Cremona printings — a further stratum of the great mystical midrash on the Torah.

unresolved.title: Cabala Hebraeorum (from Oedipus Aegyptiacus)
unresolved.author: Athanasius Kircher
unresolved.epithet: Kircher's diagram of the seventy-two names and the Tree
unresolved.summary: Kircher's treatise on the Hebrew Kabbalah within the Oedipus Aegyptiacus — his great engraved Tree of the sefirot and the seventy-two names, the Baroque Jesuit's reading of Jewish mysticism.

unresolved.title: Absconditorum a constitutione mundi clavis
unresolved.author: Guillaume Postel
unresolved.epithet: Postel's key to the things hidden since the world's foundation
unresolved.summary: Postel's Kabbalistic 'key to things hidden since the foundation of the world' — the visionary Orientalist's attempt to found a universal restitution on the Zohar, which he was the first Christian to translate.

unresolved.title: Etz Chaim (Koretz edition)
unresolved.author: Hayyim Vital
unresolved.epithet: The Tree of Life: Luria's system as recorded by Vital
unresolved.summary: Vital's record of Isaac Luria's teaching — the tzimtzum, the worlds, the partzufim and the tikkun — the fundamental text of Lurianic Kabbalah, in its early Koretz printing.

unresolved.title: Tomer Devorah
unresolved.author: Moses Cordovero
unresolved.epithet: The Palm Tree of Deborah: imitating the sefirot
unresolved.summary: Cordovero's short ethical classic teaching the imitation of the divine qualities of the sefirot — the little book that turned the abstract theology of the Kabbalah into a practical ethics of character.

unresolved.title: Ayelet Ahavim
unresolved.author: Solomon Alkabetz
unresolved.query: Ayelet Ahavim Alkabetz Song of Songs
unresolved.epithet: A Safed Kabbalist's commentary on the Song of Songs
unresolved.summary: Alkabetz's Kabbalistic commentary on the Song of Songs — the mystical eros of the Safed circle, from the poet who composed the Sabbath hymn Lekhah Dodi.

unresolved.title: Shiur Komah (Cordovero)
unresolved.author: Moses Cordovero
unresolved.epithet: Cordovero's exposition of the divine 'stature'
unresolved.summary: Cordovero's Kabbalistic exposition arranged around the ancient Shiur Komah motif of the divine dimensions — a compact window on his ordering of the sefirotic world.

unresolved.title: Sefer Yetzirah with commentaries
unresolved.author: anonymous
unresolved.epithet: The Book of Formation with its classic commentaries
unresolved.summary: The Sefer Yetzirah, the terse ancient book of the thirty-two paths and the ten sefirot, printed with the classic commentaries — the seed-text from which all later Kabbalistic cosmology grew.

unresolved.title: Sefer ha-Rokeach
unresolved.author: Eleazar of Worms
unresolved.epithet: The Perfumer: piety and secrets of the German Hasidim
unresolved.summary: Eleazar of Worms's compendium of law, ethics and the esoteric lore of the Hasidei Ashkenaz — the German-Jewish pietist mysticism of angels, names and letters that ran parallel to the Spanish Kabbalah.

unresolved.title: Kabbala: Studien über die jüdische Geheimlehre
unresolved.author: Adolph Jellinek
unresolved.query: Jellinek Moses ben Schem-Tob de Leon Kabbala
unresolved.epithet: Jellinek on Moses de León and the authorship of the Zohar
unresolved.summary: Jellinek's monograph marshalling the evidence that Moses de León composed the Zohar — the study that settled the modern scholarly view of the book's authorship.

unresolved.title: The Book of Formation (Sepher Yetzirah)
unresolved.author: Knut Stenring
unresolved.query: The Book of Formation Sepher Yetzirah Stenring
unresolved.epithet: A diagrammed English Sefer Yetzirah
unresolved.summary: Stenring's translation of the Sefer Yetzirah, with the thirty-two paths tabulated and a Golden-Dawn-flavoured commentary and an introduction by Waite — a favourite English edition of the occult revival.

unresolved.title: Le Livre des splendeurs
unresolved.author: Éliphas Lévi
unresolved.epithet: Lévi's Kabbalistic testament, published after his death
unresolved.summary: The posthumous collection of Lévi's Kabbalistic writings on the Hermetic and Jewish tradition — the mature esoteric Kabbalah of the man who reinvented magic for the modern world.

unresolved.title: Ari Nohem
unresolved.author: Leone Modena
unresolved.epithet: The rabbi who argued the Zohar was a forgery
unresolved.summary: Modena's sharp critique of the Kabbalah and of the antiquity of the Zohar — a rare early modern rationalist attack on the tradition from within Judaism, unprinted until the nineteenth century.

unresolved.title: Ta'alumot Chochmah
unresolved.author: Joseph Solomon Delmedigo
unresolved.epithet: A polymath weighs the wisdom of the Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: Delmedigo's collection — including the Matzref la-Chochmah — surveying and partly defending the Kabbalah with the eye of a Galilean-trained scientist, a singular early-modern engagement with the tradition.

unresolved.title: Sha'arei Tzedek
unresolved.author: Joseph Gikatilla
unresolved.query: Shaarei Tzedek Gikatilla Gates of Justice
unresolved.epithet: The Gates of Justice: the ten sefirot named
unresolved.summary: Gikatilla's companion to the Gates of Light, expounding the divine names attached to each of the ten sefirot — a lucid map of the Kabbalistic tree by one of its clearest teachers.

unresolved.title: Puerta del Cielo (Gate of Heaven)
unresolved.author: Abraham Cohen de Herrera
unresolved.query: Puerta del Cielo Herrera Porta Coelorum
unresolved.epithet: The Lurianic Kabbalah in Neoplatonic dress
unresolved.summary: Herrera's philosophical exposition of the Lurianic Kabbalah in the language of Renaissance Neoplatonism — the work Knorr von Rosenroth translated into Latin to bring Luria to Christian Europe.

unresolved.title: Sefer ha-Peliah
unresolved.author: anonymous
unresolved.epithet: The Book of Wonder on the first chapters of Genesis
unresolved.summary: An anonymous fourteenth-century Kabbalistic work — the 'Book of Wonder' — expounding the opening of Genesis through the mystical reading of the letters, an important text of the later Spanish Kabbalah.

unresolved.title: Tefillah le-Moshe
unresolved.author: Moses Cordovero
unresolved.epithet: Cordovero's Kabbalistic commentary on the prayers
unresolved.summary: Cordovero's mystical commentary on the liturgy, mapping the words of the daily prayers onto the ascent through the sefirot — the devotional application of his great system.

unresolved.title: Chayei ha-Olam ha-Ba
unresolved.author: Abraham Abulafia
unresolved.query: Chayei ha-Olam ha-Ba Abulafia Life of the World to Come
unresolved.epithet: The ecstatic's manual of letter-permutation
unresolved.summary: Abulafia's 'Life of the World to Come', the most detailed of his guides to the meditative permutation of the letters of the divine name as a technique of ecstasy and prophecy.

unresolved.title: The Essenes: Their History and Doctrines
unresolved.author: Christian D. Ginsburg
unresolved.query: The Essenes Their History and Doctrines Ginsburg
unresolved.epithet: The mystical sect behind the Kabbalah's roots
unresolved.summary: Ginsburg's study of the Essenes, the ascetic Jewish sect he read as a channel of the mystical doctrines that later fed the Kabbalah — the companion to his classic essay on the Kabbalah itself.

unresolved.title: The Sepher Ha-Zohar, or Book of Light
unresolved.author: Nurho de Manhar
unresolved.query: Sepher ha-Zohar Book of Light Nurho de Manhar
unresolved.epithet: An English Zohar for the Bereshith
unresolved.summary: De Manhar's English rendering of the opening sections of the Zohar, serialized for American theosophical readers — one of the earliest sustained English versions of the Book of Splendour.

unresolved.title: The Holy Kabbalah
unresolved.author: Arthur Edward Waite
unresolved.epithet: Waite's summa of the Kabbalistic tradition
unresolved.summary: Waite's large final study of the Kabbalah, its literature and its Christian afterlife — the culmination of his lifelong engagement and long a standard English survey of the whole subject.

unresolved.title: Conjectura Cabbalistica
unresolved.author: Henry More
unresolved.epithet: A Cabalistic reading of the days of creation
unresolved.summary: More's threefold Cabalistic interpretation of the mind of Moses in the opening of Genesis — the Cambridge Platonist's attempt at a philosophical, Christian Kabbalah.

unresolved.title: Two Hundred Queries concerning the Revolution of Human Souls
unresolved.author: Francis Mercury van Helmont
unresolved.query: Two Hundred Queries Revolution of Human Souls van Helmont
unresolved.epithet: The Christian Kabbalist's case for reincarnation
unresolved.summary: Van Helmont's queries arguing the Kabbalistic doctrine of gilgul — the revolution of souls — for a Christian readership, drawn from the Kabbala Denudata circle.

unresolved.title: A Kabbalistical Dialogue
unresolved.author: anonymous
unresolved.query: Kabbalistical Dialogue nature of matter Kabbala Denudata
unresolved.epithet: The one substance argued from the Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: The short 'Kabbalistical Dialogue' from the Kabbala Denudata circle, arguing that spirit and matter are one substance — a distilled statement of Christian-Kabbalistic monism.

unresolved.title: The Canon
unresolved.author: William Stirling
unresolved.query: The Canon Stirling secret of nature and art
unresolved.epithet: The hidden law of number in sacred art
unresolved.summary: Stirling's study of the 'canon' of number and proportion he believed underlay the sacred architecture, scripture and art of the ancient world — a cornerstone of English gematria.

unresolved.title: Cosmic Symbolism
unresolved.author: Sepharial
unresolved.epithet: Number, name and the hidden correspondences
unresolved.summary: Sepharial's essays on the symbolism of number, name and time — gematria, the Kabalah of numbers and astral correspondence — from a leading English astrologer of the occult revival.

unresolved.title: The Book of Charms and Talismans
unresolved.author: Sepharial
unresolved.query: The Book of Charms and Talismans Sepharial
unresolved.epithet: Seals, squares and the names of power
unresolved.summary: Sepharial's handbook of talismans, magic squares and the Kabbalistic names and seals used to make them — a practical companion to the number-magic of the tradition.

unresolved.title: Q.B.L., or the Bride's Reception
unresolved.author: Frater Achad
unresolved.epithet: A fresh key to the Tree of Life
unresolved.summary: Achad's short, influential handbook of Hermetic Qabalah, proposing a new arrangement of the Tree of Life — the work of Crowley's 'magical son', Charles Stansfeld Jones.

unresolved.title: The Art of Drawing Spirits into Crystals
unresolved.author: Johannes Trithemius
unresolved.query: Art of Drawing Spirits into Crystals Trithemius
unresolved.epithet: Angelic magic by the names of God
unresolved.summary: The short English treatise ascribed to Trithemius on summoning spirits into a crystal by the Kabbalistic names of God and the hierarchy of angels — a staple of English ceremonial magic.

unresolved.title: Qabbalah: The Philosophical Writings of Ibn Gebirol
unresolved.author: Isaac Myer
unresolved.query: Qabbalah Isaac Myer Ibn Gebirol Solomon
unresolved.epithet: An American Kabbalist's illustrated system
unresolved.summary: Myer's large illustrated study of the Kabbalah through the philosophy of Solomon ibn Gabirol, with diagrams of the sefirot and the four worlds — a richly documented Victorian synthesis.

unresolved.title: Numbers: Their Occult Power and Mystic Virtues
unresolved.author: W. Wynn Westcott
unresolved.query: Numbers Their Occult Power and Mystic Virtues Westcott
unresolved.epithet: The Golden Dawn founder on sacred number
unresolved.summary: Westcott's compendium of the mystical meanings of the numbers from Pythagoras through the Kabbalah — a small classic of number-symbolism by a founder of the Golden Dawn.

unresolved.title: The Kabbalah Unveiled (1912 edition)
unresolved.author: S. L. MacGregor Mathers
unresolved.epithet: The Zoharic texts of the Golden Dawn's Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: Mathers's English rendering, from Knorr von Rosenroth's Latin, of the Book of Concealed Mystery and the Greater and Lesser Holy Assembly — the Kabbalah the Golden Dawn actually used.

unresolved.title: The Egyptian Revival
unresolved.author: Frater Achad
unresolved.query: The Egyptian Revival Frater Achad Tree of Life
unresolved.epithet: A restored order of the Tarot on the Tree
unresolved.summary: Achad's argument for a restored attribution of the tarot trumps to the paths of the Tree of Life — a much-debated intervention in the Hermetic Qabalah of the Golden Dawn tradition.

unresolved.title: Berashith: An Essay in Ontology
unresolved.author: Aleister Crowley
unresolved.epithet: A Qabalistic meditation on the Nothing
unresolved.summary: Crowley's early essay reading the first word of Genesis through the Qabalistic doctrine of the negative veils — nothingness, the point and the emergence of the worlds.

unresolved.title: The Isiac Tablet of Cardinal Bembo
unresolved.author: W. Wynn Westcott
unresolved.query: Isiac Tablet of Cardinal Bembo Westcott
unresolved.epithet: An occult reading of the Bembine Table
unresolved.summary: Westcott's esoteric interpretation of the Bembine Table of Isis, mapping its figures to the Kabbalistic and Hermetic systems — a set piece of Golden Dawn symbolism.

unresolved.title: Nature's Symphony, or Lessons in Number Vibration
unresolved.author: L. Dow Balliett
unresolved.epithet: The music of number and the name
unresolved.summary: Balliett's sequel developing her system of number-vibration and its links to colour and music — a further elaboration of the Pythagorean-Kabbalistic numerology she founded.

unresolved.title: The Kabala of Numbers
unresolved.author: Sepharial
unresolved.epithet: The occult meaning and power of number
unresolved.summary: Sepharial's manual of the mysticism of numbers — their occult meanings, their use in prediction and their roots in the Kabbalistic tradition — a staple of the English number-lore shelf.

unresolved.title: The Kabalah and the Kabalists
unresolved.author: H. P. Blavatsky
unresolved.epithet: Theosophy's verdict on the Jewish mysteries
unresolved.summary: Blavatsky's essay weighing the Kabbalah against her 'secret doctrine' — the Theosophical reading that shaped how a generation of English occultists approached Jewish mysticism.

unresolved.title: The Fall of Adam and Genesis of the Grail
unresolved.author: various
unresolved.query: Fall of Adam Genesis Grail Kabbalah
unresolved.epithet: The Edenic myth read on the Tree of Life
unresolved.summary: A Golden-Dawn-adjacent tract reading the fall of Adam and the myth of Eden through the Kabbalistic Tree of Life and the doctrine of Adam Kadmon.

unresolved.title: Mystic Christianity
unresolved.author: William Walker Atkinson
unresolved.query: Mystic Christianity Yogi Ramacharaka inner teachings
unresolved.epithet: The inner teachings behind the Gospels
unresolved.summary: Atkinson's ('Ramacharaka') account of the inner, mystical teachings he saw behind Christianity — Kabbalistic and Gnostic currents dressed for the New Thought reader.

unresolved.title: Cosmology, or Universal Science
unresolved.author: Franz Hartmann
unresolved.query: Cosmology Universal Science Hartmann Secret Symbols
unresolved.epithet: The Rosicrucian Kabbalah of the Secret Symbols
unresolved.summary: Hartmann's exposition of the 'Secret Symbols of the Rosicrucians', a Christian-Kabbalistic cosmology of the macrocosm and microcosm — the Rose Cross reading of the Tree and the worlds.

unresolved.title: Gematria (Liber 500)
unresolved.author: Aleister Crowley
unresolved.query: Gematria Crowley Equinox Temple of Solomon
unresolved.epithet: Crowley's essay on the Qabalistic art of number
unresolved.summary: Crowley's essay on gematria, notariqon and temurah — the Qabalistic methods of reading number and letter — first printed in The Equinox as a key to his Hermetic Qabalah.

unresolved.title: Genesis with a Talmudical Commentary
unresolved.author: Paul Isaac Hershon
unresolved.query: Genesis with a Talmudical Commentary Hershon
unresolved.epithet: The rabbinic and mystical lore on Genesis
unresolved.summary: Hershon's compilation of the Talmudic and later commentary on Genesis, gathering the rabbinic and Kabbalistic legends of creation, Adam and the fall for the English reader.

unresolved.title: Numbers: Their Occult Power and Mystic Virtues
unresolved.author: W. Wynn Westcott
unresolved.query: Numbers Occult Power Mystic Virtues Westcott third edition
unresolved.epithet: Sacred number from Pythagoras to the sefirot
unresolved.summary: Westcott's enlarged handbook of the mystical meanings of the numbers — Pythagorean, Kabbalistic and Biblical — a small classic of number-symbolism by a founder of the Golden Dawn.

unresolved.title: The Royal Masonic Cyclopaedia
unresolved.author: Kenneth R. H. Mackenzie
unresolved.query: Royal Masonic Cyclopaedia Mackenzie Kabbalah Sephiroth
unresolved.epithet: The occultist's dictionary, rich in Kabbalah
unresolved.summary: Mackenzie's cyclopaedia, steeped in the Rosicrucian and Kabbalistic lore of the SRIA — its long entries on the sefirot, the divine names and the Tree fed straight into the Golden Dawn.

unresolved.title: Melchizedek and the Mystery of Fire
unresolved.author: Manly P. Hall
unresolved.query: Melchizedek and the Mystery of Fire Hall
unresolved.epithet: The fire-mysticism behind the traditions
unresolved.summary: Hall's early essay on the mystery of Melchizedek and the hidden fire-wisdom running through the Kabbalah and the Western esoteric traditions.

unresolved.title: The Book of Black Magic and of Pacts
unresolved.author: Arthur Edward Waite
unresolved.query: Book of Black Magic and of Pacts Waite Key of Solomon
unresolved.epithet: The grimoires and their Kabbalistic names
unresolved.summary: Waite's critical survey of the grimoire literature — the Keys of Solomon and their rites — reprinting the Kabbalistic circles, seals and divine names on which the ceremonial magic turns.

unresolved.title: Unheard-of Curiosities concerning Talismanical Sculpture
unresolved.author: Jacques Gaffarel
unresolved.epithet: Talismans and the celestial Hebrew alphabet
unresolved.summary: The English Gaffarel — on talismanic sculpture, the 'reading' of the stars in the shapes of the Hebrew letters, and Kabbalistic astrology — a curiosity of Christian-Kabbalistic learning.

unresolved.title: Of Geomancy
unresolved.author: Henry Cornelius Agrippa
unresolved.query: Agrippa Of Geomancy fourth book names
unresolved.epithet: Divination by the names and the spirits
unresolved.summary: Agrippa's English 'Of Geomancy', bound with the Fourth Book — divination worked through the Kabbalistic names of God, the angels and the intelligences of the planets.
